skill.name: social-media-finder-skill
skill.description: Find public social media profiles for a supplied person, brand, or business through BrowserAct. It creates a BrowserAct workflow task, polls for completion, and returns profile data or a CSV link.
skill.summary: Runs a BrowserAct workflow to find public social media profiles and return profile details.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The core network behavior is real: the script sends a supplied name and BrowserAct API key to BrowserAct, then polls for results. Most Markdown backtick and system-reconnaissance alerts are false positives, but credential handling guidance and people-profiling use cases create privacy and abuse risk.

remediation.suggestion: Instruct users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in an environment variable or secret store. Do not ask users to paste the key into chat.
Remove prompts for candidates, old friends, identity verification, and contact database collection. Add consent and legitimate-purpose limits.
Clearly disclose that names, task ids, and profile results are processed by BrowserAct. Require confirmation before each run.
Avoid proactive execution for people searches. Ask users to confirm the target, scope, and lawful basis first.

content.value_statement: Finding official social profiles across platforms is slow and error-prone. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow, returns profile data, and gives a CSV link when available.
actual_capabilities: Runs a BrowserAct workflow for a supplied person, brand, or business name.
Creates a task through the BrowserAct workflow API.
Polls BrowserAct until the task finishes, fails, or times out.
Prints the final task output returned by BrowserAct.
Documents CSV fields for platform, followers, title, description, and profile URL.
Reports invalid authorization, concurrency limits, task failures, and timeouts.
limitations: Requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY and an active BrowserAct account.
Sends search targets and task data to BrowserAct.
May take several minutes and can poll for up to 15 minutes.
Does not verify identity, consent, or legal permission for found profiles.

use_cases.title: Map a Brand Presence
use_cases.description: Find public social channels for a company before a marketing audit or support review.

use_cases.title: Research Approved Sales Accounts
use_cases.description: Locate public company and contact profiles for accounts that are already approved for outreach.

use_cases.title: Audit Owned Public Profiles
use_cases.description: Check a person or organization profile list when the owner requested a public footprint review.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Brand Presence
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search for public brand channels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to find public social media profiles for Tesla. Return platform names, profile URLs, and any CSV link.

prompt_templates.title: Research an Approved Prospect
prompt_templates.scenario: User confirms consent and business purpose.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find public social profiles for Jane Smith at ExampleCo. I have approval for outreach research. Summarize likely matches and uncertainty.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Competitor Channels
prompt_templates.prompt: Find public social profiles for Acme Robotics. Highlight platforms, follower counts, and profiles that look official.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Privacy-Aware Batch
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with confirmation and separate searches.
prompt_templates.prompt: For these approved brand names, run one search at a time. Ask before each run, then combine the profile summaries.

output_examples.input: Find public social media profiles for Acme Robotics.
output: Likely profiles were found on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X.
The returned data includes profile URLs, page titles, descriptions, and follower counts when available.
A CSV download link is available from the BrowserAct result.

output_examples.input: Check my public social footprint for Jordan Lee.
output: The workflow returned several profiles that may match the supplied name.
Each match needs manual review before it is treated as the same person.
The result includes a CSV link for follow-up review.

output_examples.input: Find profiles for a company, but the API key is missing.
output: The task cannot run until BROWSERACT_API_KEY is configured.
Set the key in the environment or a secret manager before retrying.

best_practices: Use the skill only for public profiles and a legitimate research purpose.
Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in a secure environment variable before running the script.
Manually verify profile matches before making contact, hiring, or compliance decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to stalk, harass, dox, or profile private individuals.
Do not paste API keys into chat, tickets, documents, or shared logs.
Do not treat returned profiles as verified identity matches without review.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY for the BrowserAct workflow API.

faq.question: Where does the search run?
faq.answer: The local script sends a workflow request to BrowserAct and polls BrowserAct for results.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return platform names, follower counts, page titles, description snippets, profile URLs, and a CSV link.

faq.question: Can it verify a person identity?
faq.answer: No. It can find possible public profiles, but a human must verify identity and context.

faq.question: Is it safe to use for recruiting?
faq.answer: Use it only with consent, a lawful basis, and relevant compliance review for your location.

faq.question: What happens if BrowserAct is busy?
faq.answer: The script reports concurrency limit errors and asks the user to resolve the BrowserAct account limit.
